Parameters.Description: Role limit in seconds. IAM accepts 3600 to 43200. A caller can still ask for a shorter session with --duration-seconds 900.
Use true when the assuming principal is a human IAM user. A role session cannot present MFA.
Shared identifier against the confused deputy problem. Not a secret.
The one principal allowed to assume the role, for example arn:aws:iam::<audit account>:root.

Description: kvs-iam-readonly. Customer managed read-only policy (metadata only, data reads denied) and a role that one trusted principal can assume with an ExternalId. Real account only. The Learner Lab sandbox refuses IAM writes.
